laws.tp: domestic work: Domestic workers in the occupations listed in the executive regulations (incl. farmer, gardener, household shepherd, horse groomer, falcon tamer per MOHRE); replaced Federal Law 10/2017. coded.vl: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
coded.n: Dedicated decree-law; the general labor law (FDL 33/2021) excludes domestic workers. Scope limited to occupations listed in the Executive Regulations.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
coded.n: Employment Agreement on the Ministry form, copy delivered to the worker; contracts and forms in Arabic plus a language the worker understands.
No statutory minimum wage. Art. 28(3) sets a minimum income for the employer, not a wage floor.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: Monthly wage in UAE dirhams within 10 days of the due date, proved by receipt; deductions capped at one quarter. Payment through the Wage Protection System is required for 5 domestic occupations and voluntary for the other 14.

coded.vl: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
coded.n: Daily rest of at least 12 hours, 8 of them consecutive (so at most 12 hours of work a day); no weekly limit and no overtime rule.

coded.vl: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
coded.n: Paid weekly rest day; the worker may be required to work it for another rest day or a day's wage, but not on more than two consecutive rest days in two weeks unless agreed.

coded.vl: Equal to or longer than for other workers
coded.n: At least 30 days' paid annual leave; return ticket every two years.

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: Express right, or retention by employers prohibited with a penalty
coded.n: Employer must ensure the worker's right to keep their own identification documents; withholding them carries a fine of AED 500.

coded.vl: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
coded.n: Employer must provide suitable accommodation; no rule on living out.

coded.vl: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: Transfer during the contract needs the employer's written consent and Ministry approval; without consent only after a judicial decision that the employer breached its obligations, or immediately in cases of assault (reported to the authorities). No exit permit is required.
coded.src: FDL 9/2022 arts 20-21; Ministerial Resolution 674/2022 art. 2; Cabinet Resolution 106/2022

coded.vl: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
coded.n: Agencies may not demand or accept any commission or expenses from the worker; employers may not take any amount from the worker.

coded.vl: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
coded.n: Licensing by the Ministry; agency bears return costs and is the employer under temporary employment.

coded.vl: Inspection of households allowed under stated safeguards
coded.n: Inspectors may enter the employer's home with the owner's or the Public Prosecution's permission, on a complaint or reasonable evidence.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
coded.n: Ministry settlement within two weeks; the Ministry decides claims up to AED 50,000 with review by the courts (as amended in 2023); worker lawsuits are fee-exempt and urgent; three-month limit after the end of employment.

coded.vl: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
coded.n: Employer bears medical care or health insurance and work-injury compensation; 30 days' sick leave (15 full pay, 15 half pay). No maternity leave, unemployment insurance or pension. End-of-service gratuity: art. 22 leaves it to the Cabinet and no resolution has been issued (checked 12 Nov. 2026); the often-cited 14 days a year came from the repealed Federal Law 10/2017.

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.n: Sexual harassment, forced labor and discrimination prohibited in recruitment; employer must treat the worker with dignity and protect bodily safety.

dec.n: Gratuity before one year of service
dec.pe: A worker who left before a year asked for end-of-service pay. The court said the law then in force required a full year. The 2021 law keeps a one-year threshold. [Check.]
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja yang berhenti sebelum setahun meminta pesangon. Pengadilan menyatakan UU yang berlaku saat itu mensyaratkan setahun penuh. UU 2021 tetap memakai batas satu tahun. [Periksa.]

dec.n: Employer stopped paying salary without formally ending the contract
dec.ct: Abu Dhabi Court of Cassation (as reported)
dec.pe: A company stopped paying an employee from mid-2025 but never told her in writing that her job had ended. The court said she was still employed and ordered the company to pay her wages, gratuity and leave.
dec.pi: Sebuah perusahaan berhenti menggaji karyawan sejak pertengahan 2025 tetapi tidak pernah memberi tahu secara tertulis bahwa pekerjaannya berakhir. Pengadilan menyatakan ia masih bekerja dan memerintahkan perusahaan membayar gaji, pesangon, dan cuti.

dec.n: Waiver of end-of-service benefits signed during employment
dec.pe: An employee had signed a paper giving up end-of-service pay while still working. The court said such a waiver does not count and ordered the benefits paid.
dec.pi: Seorang karyawan menandatangani surat melepaskan pesangon saat masih bekerja. Pengadilan menyatakan pelepasan itu tidak berlaku dan memerintahkan pesangon dibayar.
